jobs.occupation: Junior Aircraft Engineer (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description: DescriptionWe are Ryanair Engineering Germany GmbH.Based at Berlin Brandenburg Airport BER, we were founded in 2018 and are a 100% subsidiary of Ryanair.The Irish airline group currently operates a fleet of 590 modern Boeing 737NG and MAX 10, Boeing 737-8200 Game Changer, and Airbus A320 aircrafts. We will continue to expand by more than 300 aircraft by 2030.At Ryanair Engineering Germany, our engineers and mechanics are responsible for the maintenance of all Ryanair aircrafts in multiple stations all across Germany.We are currently looking for Junior Aircraft Engineers (f/m/d) to join our team across Berlin Brandenburg (BER) and Hahn (HHN) airport.The 24-month Junior Aircraft Engineer Program is dedicated to providing you with the required practical training and experience in order to become a licensed engineer. During the first phase (12 months), the program combines a range of theoretical and practical elements which will develop your skills as an engineer for a successful career in our Engineering department. At the end of the 12 months, you will be in a position to apply for your Category A License. At the end of the second phase of the program, you will be in a position to apply for your CAT A or B1 or B2 license.Requirements- Hold full Basic Training Certificate (CAT A or B) from an EASA Part 147 Approved School- Hold an approved CEFR B1 Standard certificate or equivalent (non-native speakers only)- EU Driving License- Good Basic Hand skills- Must have initiative; enthusiasm and be self-motivated to work in a highly rewarding and safe environment- Good English skills- Flexibility / willingness to travel and work in shifts- Entitled to work freely within the European UnionBenefits- Direct employment with a German contract- Career possibilities in Ryanair Group- Payment of shift credits- Competitive salary- Certified trainings- Free English and German courses- Monthly charged shopping card “Sodexo”- Provided Working gear and tools- Working in a diverse and international team with equal chances for ALL

contract research and development for customers in the (bio) pharmaceutical industry worldwide.You will be a vital part of our contract research organization – where you will support & learn from our scientific operations teams – to enable our clients in their journey of developing innovative drugs.Your ResponsibilityAs Senior Scientist you are - together with the project team - responsible for knowledge in CE and related areas and drive CE innovation to meet evolving business needs, including new business areas and novel molecular modalities.- Work cooperatively across Coriolis teams (e.g., Sofern nicht anders vereinbart, erlauben Sie dem einstellenden Unternehmen von Amazon durch Einreichung Ihres Lebenslaufs, Ihre persönlichen Daten in der elektronischen Datenbank zu speichern, die von Amazon Corporate LLC. in den USA oder von einer Tochtergesellschaft zum Zweck der Feststellung Ihrer Eignung für diese und für zukünftig angebotene Stellen sowie zur Verfolgung Ihres Bewerbungsprozesses unterhalten wird. Amazon gibt Ihre Daten ohne Ihre vorherige Zustimmung nicht an Dritte weiter. Im Rahmen des Interviewprozesses mit Amazon werden Sie möglicherweise dazu aufgefordert, dem einstellenden Unternehmen von Amazon zu gestatten, Ihre Bewerbungsdaten und Ihren Lebenslauf separat durch einen Drittanbieter prüfen zu lassen.

jobs.occupation: Structural Engineer (all genders) - Material Testing & Structural Validation (Statiker/in)
jobs.description: Structural Engineer (all genders) - Material Testing & Structural ValidationHelp Accelerate Industrial DecarbonizationJoin exceptional people from around the world to solve some of the world's toughest energy challenges, make a real impact, and enjoy the adventure of building the future of industrial decarbonization together.As our Structural Engineer – Material Testing & Structural Validation, you'll play a key role in developing the lightweight structural systems that make GlassPoint's technology reliable, safe, and scalable.Working closely with Structural, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Operations teams, you'll combine advanced engineering analysis with hands-on testing to validate innovative designs and ensure they perform under real-world conditions. From small-scale material characterization to full-scale component testing, your work will directly influence the next generation of technology. Your ImpactThe structures you validate will become part of some of the world's largest industrial solar thermal plants, helping heavy industry reduce emissions while improving energy security.You'll combine engineering theory with practical experimentation, transforming test results into optimized designs and helping GlassPoint continuously improve the performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of its technology.What You'll DoDesign & Improve Structural Systems- Analyze and optimize lightweight structural systems, components, and structural connections.- Evaluate the behavior of steel, aluminum, composite materials, and ETFE film systems.- Support the development of innovative structural concepts for industrial solar thermal applications.- Transform engineering insights into scalable, manufacturable design improvements.Lead Material & Component Testing- Plan, build, execute, and evaluate material and component tests.- Design and instrument full-scale structural testing.- Conduct small-specimen material testing to characterize material behavior.- Analyze test results and translate findings into engineering recommendations.Develop & Validate Engineering Models- Develop, calibrate, and improve nonlinear finite element (FEA) models.- Predict structural behavior using numerical simulations.- Validate simulation results through physical testing.- Continuously refine engineering models to improve design accuracy.Collaborate Across Engineering- Work closely with Structural, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Operations teams.- Support design decisions through data-driven engineering.- Contribute to solving complex structural challenges across international projects.- Share technical expertise and help drive continuous innovation.Who You AreYou're someone who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges and turning analysis into practical solutions.You combine analytical thinking with a hands-on mindset and enjoy moving between simulations, laboratory testing, and real-world engineering. You're curious, collaborative, and motivated by seeing your work become part of technologies that make a global impact.Ideally, you'll bring:- A degree in Structural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline (ideally with a background in construction, civil engineering, or automotive engineering).- Several years of experience in structural, material, or component testing.- Experience working with nonlinear material behavior and structural analysis.- Strong experience with numerical modelling and nonlinear FEA.- Hands-on experience planning and executing engineering tests.- Familiarity with sensors, instrumentation, and measurement systems.- A structured, analytical, and independent working style.- Confidence working in an international engineering environment.- Excellent English communication skills; German is an advantage.- Experience with foundation systems for solar structures, soil testing, rammed piles, ground screws, or percussion drilling is a plus.What You'll Find at GlassPoint- Real ownership and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact from day one.- Exceptional colleagues from diverse disciplines who challenge, support, and learn from each other.- Complex challenges that require curiosity, collaboration, and innovation.- An international team united by a shared purpose and ambitious goals.- The adventure of helping build the future of industrial decarbonization. We value inclusion and foster a culture of belonging, welcoming team members of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, gender identity, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We have zero tolerance for discrimination, harassment, bullying, or retaliation. GlassPoint helps heavy industry decarbonize by replacing fuel-based steam with solar thermal heat. This reduces energy costs and improves long-term energy security.  We’re a proven technology, already operating some of the world’s largest solar steam projects across sun-belt regions in oil and gas, metals, and mining.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Materialwissenschaft, Konstruktion, Versuchsdurchführung und -auswertung

Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:CPO; Chief-Product-Officer; Product OwnerStellenbeschreibung:About HeyGermanyGermany urgently needs international talent. Yet complex and lengthy recognition processes prevent many qualified professionals from working in the jobs they trained for. At the same time, employers struggle to fill critical positions.HeyGermany wants to change that. We are building the digital infrastructure to make professional recognition and work integration faster and easier. We are starting with nursing and plan to expand into other regulated professions. Our mission is to remove bureaucratic barriers and help international talent access jobs that match their qualifications.The RoleWe are looking for a hands-on, product-driven Founding CTPO with the ambition to build HeyGermany as a co-founder. You will take full ownership of both product and technology, from understanding customer problems and defining our product vision to building, launching and scaling the solutions.You will work closely with the Founder & CEO to shape company strategy, identify growth opportunities and turn our vision into a product that users love and businesses are willing to pay for.We already have a live MVP (www.hey-germany.com (http://www.hey-germany.com) ), an initial recognition engine and talent pool, 400+ talent pool conversions, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding.Your challenge is to turn this foundation into a scalable, user-centric platform that can take HeyGermany from one profession to many, while building the product and technology capabilities to support long-term growth.What You’ll Do- Own our product vision, strategy and roadmap, translating customer needs, business goals and market insights into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.- Lead product discovery and development end-to-end, from user research, problem validation and prototyping to technical implementation, launch and iteration.- Own our technology strategy and architecture, building scalable systems for qualification recognition, document processing, workflow automation and talent matching.- Turn complex regulatory and bureaucratic processes into simple, intuitive digital experiences, with a strong focus on usability, customer value and conversion.- Stay hands-on in building the product, making key technical decisions across frontend, backend, APIs, data and cloud infrastructure while maintaining a high standard of product quality.- Identify and develop AI-powered product opportunities where they create real value, particularly in document analysis, structured data extraction, intelligent matching and workflow automation.- Work directly with international professionals, employers and domain experts to understand their needs, validate assumptions and continuously improve the product.- Define and track key product metrics, using data, user feedback and experimentation to drive product decisions, engagement, conversion and business outcomes.- Build and lead our future product and engineering team, establishing a strong culture of ownership, customer focus, speed and continuous learning.What We’re Looking For- We care less about your current title than about what you have built, your product judgment and the level of ownership you are ready to take.- 7+ years of experience in software engineering, product development or technical product leadership, with strong hands-on technical capabilities.- A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.- A proven track record of building and shipping digital products end-to-end, ideally in a founder, founding engineer, product-minded CTO, technical product lead or similar role.- Strong product thinking, with the ability to identify real customer problems, validate solutions, prioritize effectively and balance user needs with business impact and technical feasibility.- Strong experience with a modern web stack, ideally TypeScript, React/Next.js, backend development, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.- Practical experience building with LLMs and modern AI systems, including RAG, agents and evaluations, and using AI effectively in product development and day-to-day work.- Experience with product discovery, user research, UX principles, product analytics and iterative development. You know how to move from an initial hypothesis to a product that delivers measurable value.- The ability to make pragmatic decisions across product and technology, balancing speed, user experience, quality and scalability in an early-stage environment.- A strong understanding of how product decisions connect to business outcomes, including acquisition, activation, retention and monetization.- A founder mindset and strong connection to our mission**.** You want real ownership, are comfortable with the ambiguity of a pre-seed company and care about building a successful business, not just great technology.- Strong English communication skills are required. German is a plus.- Experience with document intelligence/OCR, B2B SaaS, marketplaces, HR Tech, Global Mobility or regulated/GDPR-sensitive products is valuable, but not required.What We Offer- €50,000–€65,000 annual base salary, with salary growth as the company scales, plus meaningful equity reflecting the founder-level ownership of the role.- The opportunity to become a true co-founder, with long-term ownership of product and technology and meaningful participation in the company’s upside.- Founder-level influence over product vision, technology and company strategy, with the freedom to shape what we build, how we build it and how we grow.- The opportunity to build our product, technology architecture and future product and engineering organisation from the ground up.- A live product, early traction, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding. We are currently in conversations with investors for our next stage of growth.- The opportunity to work on a problem with tangible social and economic impact: helping international professionals access jobs that match their qualifications while helping employers access talent they urgently need.We believe professional opportunities should be determined by people’s skills, not by their ability to navigate bureaucracy.If you want to build both the product and the technology behind a company from the ground up, take real ownership and help shape HeyGermany as a co-founder, we would love to hear from you.Send us one product you've built that you're proud of, tell us what role you played in bringing it to life, and why this mission matters to you.katharina@hey-germany.com (https://mailto:katharina@hey-germany.com)Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

jobs.description: AURELIUS is a global alternative investor, distinguished and widely recognised for its operational approach. Its key investment platforms include AURELIUS Opportunities V, AURELIUS European Opportunities IV, AUR Portfolio III and AURELIUS Growth (Wachstumskapital). End-to-End Engineering Delivery- Own end-to-end delivery from project definition through development, industrialization, mass production ramp, and customer handover- Act as the single point of accountability for on-time, on-quality, on-cost execution of customer projects and NPIs- Drive execution discipline, cost control, and scalable delivery models across multi-site and multi-BU programs- Establish a common project lifecycle, stage-gate framework, and PMO standards applied consistently across electricity, gas, thermal, software, and analytics- Ensure robust project planning, risk management, change control, and claim management on all major programs- Chair stage-gate reviews and enforce go/no-go decisions against scope, schedule, cost, quality, and business case3. Cross-BU Solution Delivery (HW + SW + Analytics)- Lead delivery of integrated solutions combining residential and industrial meters, head-end software, and analytics offerings- Break down BU silos and orchestrate cross-BU program teams around customer outcomes, not product lines- Establish shared solution architectures and reusable delivery playbooks across product families- Ensure consistent solution scoping, pricing input, and delivery commitments across the portfolio4. NPI & Industrialization- Collaborate with Operations on NPI program management from early involvement design, to design freeze through pilot, ramp, and stable serial production- Ensure early and structured involvement of NPI, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Quality in R&D projects- Drive design-for-manufacturing, design-for-cost, and design-for-serviceability discipline into every new program- Manage ramp readiness: supply readiness, test coverage, production line qualification, and yield curves5. Cross-functional Collaboration- Act as the delivery counterpart to Product Management (portfolio & roadmap) and R&D (technology execution)- Partner with Sales and Customer Projects to translate customer commitments into feasible, margin-protected delivery plans- Provide delivery input into bids, contract negotiation, and commercial terms (milestones, LDs, acceptance criteria)- Collaborate with Procurement and SCM to secure supply, lead times, and cost targets for project ramp- Collaborate with Quality to embed quality gates and field-performance feedback into delivery governance- Align with Finance on project controlling, revenue recognition, milestone billing, and cash collection6. Financial & Resource Management- Own the project delivery cost base and the aggregated margin performance of the project portfolio- Drive project margin protection: budget adherence, contingency management, scope and change control- Optimize allocation of PM and delivery resources across customer projects and NPI programs- Drive build vs. buy vs. outsource decisions for delivery capacity, balancing control, cost, and flexibility- Support business cases and mid-term planning with realistic delivery assumptions and risk-adjusted estimates7. Transformation & Change Leadership- Lead transformation initiatives to increase delivery productivity, reduce time-to-market, and improve predictability- Standardize and digitalize PMO tooling (planning, reporting, risk, resource management)- Build a high-performance, accountable, and customer-centric delivery culture- Drive upskilling and certification of the PM community across hardware, software, and solution delivery8. Governance, Risk & Compliance- Ensure project delivery complies with contractual, regulatory, cybersecurity, and quality requirements- Establish transparent portfolio reporting to the CEO and executive team, including early warning on at-risk programs- Own risk register for the delivery portfolio and drive systematic mitigationYour ProfileProfessional Experience- Minimum 15+ years of experience in project, program, and delivery leadership, including senior roles (VP/SVP level) in an international, matrix organization- Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-functional delivery organizations spanning hardware, software, and integrated solutions- Significant experience in customer project delivery in a B2B environment (preferably utilities, energy, industrial technology, or telecom infrastructure)- Strong NPI and industrialization background: bringing new hardware and software products from development into serial production and customer rollout- Demonstrated success in owning end-to-end delivery from project definition to mass production and customer acceptance- Experience running structured stage-gate and PMO frameworks at scale, with measurable improvements in OTD, margin, and predictability- Solid commercial acumen: contract, bid, and claim management; project P&L ownership; milestone billing and working capital control- Experience in driving organizational transformation and productivity improvements (cost, efficiency, time-to-market)- Experience in global/multi-site setups, including near-/offshore delivery structures- Exposure to carve-out, integration, or major transformation programs (strong plus)Intercultural Experience- Proven leadership experience in international and cross-cultural environments, managing teams across multiple geographies- Strong experience in navigating matrix organizations and global governance structures- High level of cultural awareness, adaptability, and communication effectiveness at executive and customer level- Fluency in German and English is a prerequisitePersonal attributes- University degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field- Advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is a plus; recognized PM certifications (PMP, IPMA, PgMP, SAFe) are a plus- Strong technical understanding across hardware, embedded systems, software, and cloud/analytics solutions — able to challenge and steer technical trade-offs- Deep mastery of project and program management methods, stage-gate governance, and modern delivery models (Agile at scale, hybrid HW/SW delivery)- Proven ability to drive execution at scale in multi-site, distributed delivery organizations, including vendor and outsourcing management- Data-driven delivery mindset: use of KPIs, portfolio dashboards, and analytics to improve OTD, quality, and productivity- Strong business and P&L awareness, with ability to protect and expand project margin under commercial pressure- Ability to connect customer commitments, technical execution, and financial outcomes- Strong ROI orientation: able to challenge scope, prioritize based on value, and terminate programs that no longer meet hurdle rates- Strong decision-making capability under ambiguity, especially in evolving organizational and carve-out setups- Excellent stakeholder management skills across CEO / board level, customers, suppliers, and internal functions- High degree of resilience and change leadership capability in transformation environments- Ability to attract, develop, and retain top program and delivery talentErgänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Aufsicht, Leitung, Projektmanagement
